Unsupported syntax is explicit, and literal terminology is correctly distinguished from byte/case/diacritic-exact analyzer matching.

The authenticated search log records 17 passing tests covering expected Core/JSON/schema roundtrips, isolated execution without UI/server imports, strict decoding, snapshot substitution, limits, forged cycles, expanded aliases, partial construction, immutable children and content-free error surfaces. The failure-first UTF8 predecode regression and development adverse observations remain separate from candidate qualification. The original sandbox overall attempt remains FAIL and is not relabeled as passing.

The 27-path candidate stays within approved T01 implementation and ordinary campaign/claim publication. Three generated search schemas are additive through the existing generator; authenticated fresh predecessor comparison preserves all 36 previous generated artifact bytes, while the committed availability fixture retains 102 method/path/operation identities. Existing connector DTO and API/client contracts are preserved. All six new Python sources/tests are registered in quality scope, and selected quality, architecture, ADR and backlog-view checks pass. Proposed ADR0059 documents implementation under Accepted ADR0057 and CAP-06-D01/D06 without changing accepted authority. This pure contract has no durable mutation, migration, operational audit event or governed UX change. The publication note truthfully separates its pre-retention generated-tree checker PASS from exact historical-page retention and does not claim a final retained-tree full-byte PASS.

Inspection and the selected tests support exact/literal, phrase, Boolean, field and integer-filter roundtrips with original text and operand order preserved. Original and normalized query lengths are capped at 8192 codepoints; syntax and AST depth, 256 expanded node occurrences, 32 junction operands and 262144 UTF8 wire bytes are bounded, with at-cap and material over-cap coverage. String-aware byte/container/Unicode preflight precedes recursive JSON decoding. Duplicate members, unknown versions/fields/kinds, coercive years, invalid Unicode and malformed or cyclic graphs fail closed. Schema documentation accurately requires Core semantic loading after structural validation. Query representations and generated error surfaces omit private content; source text and ADR0029 anchor identities are unchanged.
